name: Apple AirPods Pro (2nd Generation) with MagSafe Charging Case (USB-C)
description: Experience next-level audio performance powered by the H2 chip. Features up to 2x more Active Noise Cancellation (ANC), Adaptive Audio, and Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking for immersive, theater-like sound. The updated MagSafe Charging Case features a USB-C port, a built-in speaker for Find My, and IP54 dust and water resistance.

name: Logitech MX Master 3S Wireless Performance Mouse
description: An iconic ergonomic mouse designed for ultimate productivity. Features Quiet Clicks that reduce click noise by 90% and an 8,000 DPI track-on-glass sensor for extreme precision on any surface. The MagSpeed Electromagnetic scroll wheel provides lightning-fast speed and pixel-precise control. Connect up to 3 devices simultaneously via Bluetooth or Logi Bolt.

name: Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Noise-Canceling Headphones
description: Industry-leading noise cancellation powered by two processors and eight microphones. Enjoy exceptional Hi-Res audio quality and crystal-clear hands-free calling with Precise Voice Pickup technology. Boasts up to 30 hours of battery life with quick charging capability (3 minutes of charge gives 3 hours of playback) and an ultra-comfortable lightweight design.

name: Muji Minimalist Ultrasonic Aroma Diffuser
description: Designed with a clean, minimalist aesthetic, this diffuser uses ultrasonic waves to vaporize water and essential oils without heat, preserving the oil's natural aroma. Features two adjustable LED brightness settings, doubling as a warm ambient nightlight perfect for bedrooms or workspaces.

name: Uniqlo AIRism Cotton Oversized T-Shirt (Short Sleeve)
description: The ultimate everyday tee combining a stylish streetwear silhouette with high-tech comfort. Crafted with a premium cotton exterior and Uniqlo’s proprietary AIRism smooth, moisture-wicking technology on the inside. Breathable, quick-drying, and cool to the touch—ideal for warm weather and versatile layering.

name: Muji Linen Washable Short Sleeve Shirt
description: Made from 100% high-quality French flax linen, this short-sleeve button-down offers a light, breathable feel that gets softer with every wash. Perfect for casual smart-casual outfits, summer outings, or relaxed daily wear with an effortless, natural drape.

name: Nike Dri-FIT Form Men's Versatile Shorts
description: Engineered for versatility and mobility during workouts or casual days. Built with sweat-wicking Dri-FIT technology to keep you dry and comfortable. Features a lightweight, smooth fabric, an elastic waistband with an internal drawcord, and convenient side pockets for basic storage.

name: Levi's 501 Original Fit Jeans
description: The timeless classic that started it all. Cut in an iconic straight-leg fit with a signature button fly, these jeans are crafted from 100% durable cotton denim. Designed to mold to your body over time, providing a personalized fit and an enduring style that never goes out of fashion.

name: Starbucks House Blend Coffee Capsules by Nespresso / Dolce Gusto (12 Pods)
description: Enjoy the signature flavor of Starbucks at home. A medium roast blend of fine Latin American beans roasted to a glistening, dark chestnut color. Loaded with flavor, balancing aromas of cocoa and toasted nuts with a touch of sweetness from the roast.

name: Twinings of London Earl Grey Black Tea (25 Tea Bags)
description: A legendary black tea blend scented with the fragrant oil of bergamot citrus fruit. Delivers a distinctive, refreshing citrus aroma and a smooth, balanced taste. Perfect enjoyed hot or iced, on its own or with a slice of lemon for an afternoon tea break.

name: Muji Matcha Baumkuchen Layer Cake
description: A traditional Japanese layered ring cake baked to perfection. Infused with authentic Uji matcha green tea powder, offering a rich, earthy flavor profile with a delicately sweet balance. Moist, soft, and individually portioned—ideal for pairing with hot tea or coffee.

name: Bosch IXO 7 Cordless Screwdriver (3.6V)
description: A compact, user-friendly cordless screwdriver built for everyday household tasks and flat-pack furniture assembly. Delivers 20% increased torque over its predecessor and features a 360-degree LED light ring to eliminate shadows in tight dark spaces. Easily rechargeable via Micro-USB/USB-C.

name: Stanley FatMax Tape Measure (5m / 16ft)
description: Built for professional durability, featuring a high-impact ABS case and BladeArmor coating on the first 3 inches to prevent breakage. The tape blade is coated with Mylar to withstand wear up to 10 times longer than standard blades. Equipped with clear markings and a strong magnetic hook.

name: Makita 12V Max CXT Cordless Driver Drill Kit
description: A compact yet powerful 12V driver-drill kit delivering up to 250 in.lbs. of Max Torque. Features a variable 2-speed transmission (0-450 & 0-1,700 RPM) covering a wide range of drilling and driving applications. Includes two 12V Max CXT Lithium-Ion batteries, a charger, and a durable carrying case.

name: Muji Aluminum Precision Screwdriver Set
description: A sleek, minimal precision tool kit enclosed in a lightweight aluminum case with a push-to-release mechanism. Includes high-accuracy magnetic steel bits designed for repairing small electronics, eyeglasses, watches, laptops, and smartphones.
